tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities where Socials Homes sends rental listing alerts, with each city's slug, name and country. Optionally filter by country (ISO code like "NL" or a name like "Netherlands"). Use the slug with check_city_supply and start_home_search.

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Get the Socials Homes plans with prices in EUR, how each one bills, whether it renews automatically, what it includes, how cancelling works, and the VIP Keys Pass 90-day guarantee with its conditions and a link to the terms.

tools.name: check_city_supply
tools.description: Count the live rental listings Socials Homes currently sees in a supported city and, if a monthly budget in EUR is given, how many are at or under it. Says plainly when live counts are unavailable instead of reporting zero. Read-only; the count comes from a cache refreshed about every 10 minutes.

tools.name: start_home_search
tools.description: Check that a city is supported and return the Socials Homes signup link for it, with what happens next. It does not create an account, save anything or send any message: the person opens the link and sets up their own search there.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_home_search · Public sink: start_home_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_home_search · Public sink: start_home_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
